english: Let $\lambda$ be a real number with $\lambda<-2$. Then the sum of all the principal solutions (that is, the solutions lying in $[0,2\pi)$) of the equation $\tan x+\cot x=\lambda$ is equal to
hindi: माना कि $\lambda$ एक वास्तविक संख्या है जिसके लिए $\lambda<-2$ है। तब समीकरण $\tan x+\cot x=\lambda$ के सभी मुख्य हलों (अर्थात् $[0,2\pi)$ में स्थित हलों) का योग बराबर है
solution: Principal solutions need $2x\in[0,4\pi)$: $2x=\pi+\theta,\ 2\pi-\theta,\ 3\pi+\theta,\ 4\pi-\theta$ (none is a multiple of $\frac{\pi}{2}$, so $\tan x,\cot x$ exist)
Sum of the four values of $2x$ is $10\pi$, so the sum of the principal solutions is $5\pi$, whatever $\lambda<-2$ is
solution_full: For $x$ not a multiple of $\frac{\pi}{2}$: $\tan x+\cot x=\dfrac{\sin^2x+\cos^2x}{\sin x\cos x}=\dfrac{2}{\sin 2x}$.
So the equation is $\sin 2x=\dfrac{2}{\lambda}$. Since $\lambda<-2$, $\dfrac{2}{\lambda}\in(-1,0)$; write $\sin 2x=-k$ with $0<k<1$.
Let $\theta=\sin^{-1}k$, so $0<\theta<\frac{\pi}{2}$. The general solution of $\sin 2x=\sin(-\theta)$ is $2x=n\pi+(-1)^n(-\theta)$, $n\in\mathbb{Z}$.
A principal solution satisfies $0\le x<2\pi$, i.e. $0\le 2x<4\pi$. In $[0,4\pi)$ the sine is negative only on $(\pi,2\pi)$ and $(3\pi,4\pi)$, and on each of these it takes the value $-k$ twice:
None of these $x$ is a multiple of $\frac{\pi}{2}$ (that would need $\sin 2x=0$), so $\tan x$ and $\cot x$ are defined and all four are genuine solutions.
Sum of the values of $2x$: $(\pi+\theta)+(2\pi-\theta)+(3\pi+\theta)+(4\pi-\theta)=10\pi$. Hence the sum of the principal solutions is $5\pi$, independent of $\lambda$.
(For $\lambda>2$ the same method gives $3\pi$, which is option (A).)
originality_note: New: the sum of the principal solutions is an invariant of the whole family lambda < -2 (way 4, hidden invariant), and the sign of lambda decides which quadrants of 2x carry the roots. Closest known: 'principal solutions of tan x + cot x = 2' or 'of sin 2x = -1/2' with a fixed right side. Different because: lambda is not given; the student must see that the four roots pair off around pi and 3pi.

concept_use.Principal solution vs general solution: The general solution 2x = n pi + (-1)^n(-theta) is written first and then exactly the members with x in [0, 2pi) are selected (n = 1 to 4).

stem_review: Read as a student: every symbol, function and interval is introduced before use, every condition is stated, each sentence has one reading; the answer was recomputed independently with sympy/mpmath (and a numerical scan), is unique and equals the Answer Plan. Defined 'principal solutions' in the stem as the solutions in [0, 2pi), since some books use (-pi, pi]. Changed: added the bracketed definition.
key_step: Rewriting tan x + cot x as 2/sin 2x and seeing that the four principal roots of sin 2x = -k sum to 10 pi whatever k is.
justification: Routine chain: an identity, the general solution of sin 2x = c, and selection of principal solutions; the only decision is the sign of 2/lambda. Comparable to the routine inverse-trig range work of 2026-P1-Q4 (L2).
